text.description_html:
Night Latch Function Orlando Lever for Panic Device

This is a Night Latch Function Orlando style Lever (Outside entrance by lever when latch bolt is retracted by Key) is suitable for all Wide and Medium Stile Doors (aluminum framed, hollow metal, or wood). For use on door's exterior with Panic Device Hardware. Heavy duty commercial set covers standard 2-1/8" bore hole door prep.

For use with PDQ 4200 Series Rim Exit Device, 4200 Series Vertical Rod Exit Device, Polished Brass Vertical Rod Exit Device, Polished Brass Rim Exit Device, Global TH1100EDTBAR Touch Bar Rim Exit Device, TH1100EDSVTBAR Surface Vertical Rod Panic Device.

Packaged with mounting hardware, instructions, and 2 keys.

Features for PDQ 4-SH-09-ORL Keyed Night Latch Function Lever

  • Night Latch Function (ANSI F03) - Outside entrance by lever when latch bolt is retracted by Key. (Lever only opens door when the key is turned). Key removable only when locked (Night Latch).
  • Rosette Diameter: 3-1/8"
  • Orlando Lever Length: 5-1/2"
  • Orlando Lever Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Lock Cylinder: Standard Schlage C Keyway
  • Supplied with 2 keys
  • ADA Compliant
  • PDQ 4-SH-09-ORL Installation Template & Instructions (PDF)
